title: Guava Flow Cytometry Protocol
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ikyccxw
materials: Select InCyte from the main menu
Load the following cleaning solutions: *dH 2 O in W2, W4, W5 *Empty tubes in W5, W6 *100 µL bleach in W1 *ICF in position 10 *dH 2 O in position 9 (capillary shutdown)

steps.title: Clean the instrument
steps.instruction: Open the CLEANING menu, start the cleaning cycle, and load the required cleaning solutions.

substeps.instruction: Click **CLEANING** from the main menu.
Click **START CLEAN**.
Load **deionized H₂O** into positions W1‑W6 and position 1.
Load **100 µL bleach** into position 2.
Load **GUAVA ICF** into positions 3 and 4.
Load **deionized H₂O** into the capillary shutdown (position 9).

steps.title: Warm up the instrument
steps.instruction: Allow the machine to warm up for at least ten minutes before acquiring any samples.

steps.title: Create worklist
steps.instruction: Define the acquisition parameters for the run.

substeps.instruction: Click **EDIT WORKLIST**.
Enter worklist parameters such as wells to analyze, number of events, acquisition time, dilution factor, original volume, replicates, etc.

steps.title: Run worklist
steps.instruction: Start the worklist and specify where data will be saved.

substeps.instruction: Click **RUN WORKLIST**.
Select the folder where the data file will be saved and click **SAVE**.

steps.title: Select analysis method
steps.instruction: Choose or create the analysis method to be applied to the acquired data.

substeps.instruction: If using a saved method, click **RETRIEVE**, then **OPEN**.
If creating a new method, click **NEW**, then **OK**, and set the desired parameters.

steps.title: Load sample plate
steps.instruction: Place the microtiter plate in the instrument and load it.

substeps.instruction: Place the microtiter plate in the tray.
Click **OK** to load the plate.

steps.title: Adjust acquisition settings
steps.instruction: Configure plot types, thresholds, gains, and compensation before data collection.

substeps.instruction: Select the sample for **ADJUST SETTINGS** in the dialog box.
Select the type of plots and parameters you wish to display.
Use **GAIN CONTROLS** to choose the **Threshold** parameter and adjust gains for FSC, SSC, GRN, YLW, RED, NIR, RED2, or NIR2.
To adjust compensation, click **NEXT STEP**, then **ADJUST SETTINGS**.
When all settings are finalized, click **NEXT STEP**.

steps.title: Start data acquisition
steps.instruction: Begin acquiring samples according to the defined worklist.

substeps.instruction: Click **RESUME WORKLIST**; acquisition will start automatically.
